ownership_interests_percent_check.name: ownership_interests_percent_check

accounts_masked_identifier_check.name: accounts_masked_identifier_check
accounts_masked_identifier_check.value: masked_identifier IS NULL OR (length(masked_identifier) <= 32 AND length(regexp_replace(masked_identifier, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) <= 4)

balance_snapshots_not_self_superseded_ch.name: balance_snapshots_not_self_superseded_check
balance_snapshots_not_self_superseded_ch.value: superseded_by IS NULL OR superseded_by <> id

holding_lines_value_currency_check.name: holding_lines_value_currency_check
holding_lines_value_currency_check.value: value IS NULL OR value_currency IS NOT NULL

property_details_share_check.name: property_details_share_check
property_details_share_check.value: ownership_share IS NULL OR (ownership_share > 0 AND ownership_share <= 1)

restrictions_verified_at_check.name: restrictions_verified_at_check
restrictions_verified_at_check.value: status <> 'verified' OR verified_at IS NOT NULL

journal_entries_posted_at_check.name: journal_entries_posted_at_check
journal_entries_posted_at_check.value: status = 'draft' OR posted_at IS NOT NULL

journal_entries_reversed_check.name: journal_entries_reversed_check
journal_entries_reversed_check.value: (status = 'reversed') = (reversed_by_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND reversed_at IS NOT NULL)

journal_entries_not_self_reversing_check.name: journal_entries_not_self_reversing_check
journal_entries_not_self_reversing_check.value: reverses_entry_id IS NULL OR reverses_entry_id <> id

source_records_amount_currency_check.name: source_records_amount_currency_check
source_records_amount_currency_check.value: amount IS NULL OR currency IS NOT NULL

source_records_not_self_superseded_check.name: source_records_not_self_superseded_check
source_records_not_self_superseded_check.value: superseded_by IS NULL OR superseded_by <> id

third_party_arrangements_fee_rate_check.name: third_party_arrangements_fee_rate_check
third_party_arrangements_fee_rate_check.value: fee_rate IS NULL OR (fee_rate >= 0 AND fee_rate < 1)

import_batches_file_kind_check.name: import_batches_file_kind_check
import_batches_file_kind_check.value: file_kind IS NULL OR file_kind IN ('csv', 'xlsx', 'ofx', 'qfx', 'ibkr_flex_xml', 'ibkr_flex_csv', 'pdf')

import_batches_reversal_check.name: import_batches_reversal_check
import_batches_reversal_check.value: status <> 'reversed' OR (reversed_at IS NOT NULL AND reversal_reason IS NOT NULL)

reconciliations_balanced_check.name: reconciliations_balanced_check
reconciliations_balanced_check.value: status <> 'balanced' OR (difference IS NOT NULL AND difference = 0)

exceptions_snooze_check.name: exceptions_snooze_check
exceptions_snooze_check.value: status <> 'snoozed' OR snoozed_until IS NOT NULL

job_records_progress_check.name: job_records_progress_check
job_records_progress_check.value: progress IS NULL OR (progress >= 0 AND progress <= 1)

budgets_period_check.name: budgets_period_check
budgets_period_check.value: period_end IS NULL OR period_start IS NULL OR period_end >= period_start

goal_contributions_verified_evidence_che.name: goal_contributions_verified_evidence_check
goal_contributions_verified_evidence_che.value: status <> 'verified' OR (source_record_id IS NOT NULL AND verified_at IS NOT NULL)

obligations_amount_currency_check.name: obligations_amount_currency_check
obligations_amount_currency_check.value: amount IS NULL OR currency IS NOT NULL

receivables_payables_intercompany_check.name: receivables_payables_intercompany_check
receivables_payables_intercompany_check.value: intercompany_entity_id IS NULL OR intercompany_entity_id <> entity_id

recurring_items_day_check.name: recurring_items_day_check
recurring_items_day_check.value: day_of_month IS NULL OR day_of_month BETWEEN 1 AND 31

recurring_items_amount_currency_check.name: recurring_items_amount_currency_check
recurring_items_amount_currency_check.value: amount IS NULL OR currency IS NOT NULL

reviews_completed_check.name: reviews_completed_check
reviews_completed_check.value: status <> 'completed' OR completed_at IS NOT NULL
